description:
DONE s486a (2026-09-16, Opus, worktree agent-ad5c8bcbffc408b9a on main 4429126a).

THE USER'S QUESTION: "how many of the failures are from what we don't support?"
Every blessed failing row has carried a CAUSE since #993 I3, but the causes had
never been summed by class and no runner printed the split.

THE RULE (Fable, s486; verbatim in docs/DECIDED.md s486a and in the header of
tools/lib/PCLCauses.pm): six classes, ONE function PCLCauses::cause_class --
not-supported (an `NS:` anchor ANYWHERE, or the literal `not-supported.md`
citation; it WINS over a task number, because with every filed bug fixed PCL
would still fail the row), parked (PARKED:), bug (#NNNN), unexplained
(= has_cause false), perl-skip (excluded from the share's denominator), other
(a hygiene list expected to trend to zero).  The ORDER of the tests IS the
rule.

WHAT SHIPPED
  79f0ead8  PCLCauses::cause_class / class_census / census_line + @CLASSES.
            causes_line's THIRD answer IS census_line, so tools/sweep-diff.pl,
            tools/run-perl-suite.pl and tools/cpan-scoreboard.pl --diff all
            print the split with no second reading of the column (rule 11).
            The cause-less count they always printed moved to a continuation
            line, unchanged in meaning; three tests' assertions updated.
  010e47e4  tools/cause-census.pl (six populations) + tools/t/cause-census.t
            (25 rows, fixture baselines in a tempdir).
  3cd96da7  docs/failure-cause-classes.md, DECIDED s486a, the STATUS.md table,
            the runbook pointer (writing a cause is CHOOSING its class), the
            session-log entry.

TWO DESIGN POINTS WORTH KEEPING
  * WEIGHTING.  baselines/fail-baseline.tsv is a set of KEYS -- 488 blessed
    lines stand for 635 failing rows in the Sep-6 log -- so the census is
    ROW-weighted when a .faillog is present (joined on (file, description), the
    log's DATE printed) and KEY-weighted otherwise, and it SAYS WHICH.  A run
    row with no blessed row is log/baseline DRIFT, on its own line.
  * THE SKIP REGISTRY enters the DENOMINATOR and is NEVER inferred: a
    cl/skip-registry.lisp relabel is a not-supported FAILURE the sweep's fail
    count does not contain (~180/run).  Read from _status.tsv's registry column
    when it exists (s486b adds it), printed `registry: NOT COUNTED (...)`
    otherwise.  Guessing zero would understate exactly the number this work
    exists to report.

FIRST MEASUREMENT (main 4429126a, .faillog of 2026-09-06):
  perl-tests sweep         635    ns 268  parked 69  bug 291  other 7   -> 53.1%
  companion (perl's t/) 11,984    ns 4,661 parked 88 bug 4,873 unexpl 2,362 -> 39.6%
  CPAN board               389    ns 88   bug 294   perl-skip 7          -> 23.0%
  companion XDIFF rows   2,517    ns 2,516 (by construction) unexpl 1    -> 100%
  shortfall perl-tests  12,213    ns 267  bug 104   unexpl 11,842        ->  2.2%
  shortfall perl's t/  444,439    ns 55,393 parked 417 bug 388,107 unexpl 522
  READ THE PER-POPULATION ROWS: the grand total is dominated by the t/
  shortfall's few enormous generated files.  The honest headline is the sweep's
  53% and the companion's 40%.

AGAINST THE HAND MEASUREMENT: every population TOTAL reproduces exactly.  Three
splits differ and all three are the hand grep, not the tool -- (a) one sweep row
cites `not-supported.md 'use strict refs ...'` with no NS: anchor (+1 ns);
(b) 59 rows read `partly #752 (...)`, a task number behind a hedge (291 vs 232
bug, 7 vs 67 other; 291-59=232 and 7+59+1=67 reconcile exactly); (c) a
PARKED:+task row in the companion and in the t/ shortfall.  The NS:-first /
task-then-NS: decomposition (148 + 119) matches to the row.  Written up in
docs/failure-cause-classes.md "Against Fable's hand measurement".

BARS, all green: prove tools/t/{cause-census,perl-suite-causes,audit-instruments,
cpan-scoreboard,tap-align}.t (148 rows); prove Pl/t/{license-tag-01,
no-hardcoded-paths-01,core-deps-01}.t; tools/sweep-diff.pl diff on the Sep-6 log
(prints `CAUSES: 478 of 478 -- not-supported 200, parked 47, bug 223, other 8,
unexplained 0`, the KEY-weighted view, verdict unchanged); cpan-scoreboard.pl
--diff (`CAUSES: 317 of 317 -- ... perl-skip 7`; its 317 is its KEY-collapsed
count, the census's 389 is blessed LINES -- different units, both correct);
tools/prove-core.  Nothing under Pl/ or cl/ changed, so no sweep and no
companion run (the WHAT-TO-RUN-WHEN docs/tools row).

RESIDUE: the hygiene list is 7 rows / 2 cause texts, both DECIDED "PCL has no
PVBM" (perl-tests/ref.t + postfixderef.t) -- they want the not-supported.md
section they rest on.  #1783 is the XDIFF row with no reason row.
subject: DONE s486a: the failure-cause CLASS census -- PCLCauses::cause_class (one rule, six classes), the three runners' CAUSES line becomes the split, tools/cause-census.pl + its guard, docs/failure-cause-classes.md
